name: Farewell
lead: Farewell is the final chapter of Celeste , as well as the longest and hardest. Released on September 9, 2019, as free DLC ( update 1.3.0.0 ), it features a space-themed setting, and various new mechanics such as 2-Dash Refills , Pufferfish and Jellyfish , alongside mechanics from every other chapter mixed in.
